messages:
mike (Sales): Prospect (regulated SaaS) asked for IAM evidence for SIG subset: SSO metadata, MFA enforcement language, RBAC mapping for demo roles, and service-account practice. They want a single PDF. Can we assemble by COB?

anya (Security): I will author a one-page signed statement covering MFA, service accounts, provisioning, and audit retention. Will include exact policy lines you can paste.

diego (Solutions Eng): I can produce sanitized SP metadata + a short SAML Response sample and a tiny RBAC CSV for demo roles. Will redact tenant IDs.

rachel (AE): Buyer needs to know whether admin MFA must be FIDO2 or if Okta push is allowed. Need verbatim answer for SIG form.

anya (Security): Verbatim: "Admin accounts: hardware-backed MFA (FIDO2) required for production admin privileges. Regular interactive users: Okta MFA (push/TOTP) is acceptable for non-admins. Service accounts: use ephemeral tokens (rotated, 24h max TTL)."

diego (Solutions Eng): RBAC CSV sample:
role,permissions,expiry
poc_viewer,models:read;logs:read,7d
poc_dev,models:invoke;prompts:create,7d

mike (Sales): Also need a one-liner explaining service accounts do not bypass MFA.

anya (Security): Copy-paste: "Service accounts do not use interactive MFA; they authenticate with ephemeral, scope-limited tokens issued by our token service and logged centrally."

artifact-bot: Uploaded iam_poc_bundle_178001.zip to internal bucket and created ticket SE-4510.

rachel (AE): I'll attach the ZIP and the signed PDF to the SIG response and send. If they request full ATO artifacts, we'll escalate to Legal/Security.

mike (Sales): Thanks team, sending now :rocket:
